interpretation: Sampling/pixel spacing of distributed images, distinct from optical resolution and display magnification. Dataset-level source claims; no independent scanner calibration.

bcss.note: Pinned mirror reports 0.25 micrometres/pixel and 40x equivalent; no per-file optical calibration verified. RGBs are already colour-normalized.
bcss.annotation: Structured crowdsourced tissue-class annotations from BCSS; not Bora predictions.

tiger.note: Provider states approximate 0.5 micrometres/pixel for all released ROI images and masks. Pixel spacing is not an optical resolving-power measurement.
tiger.annotation: Manual tissue compartment masks. RUMC/JB annotations by breast pathologists; TCGA regions adapted from BCSS/NuCLS.

glas.note: Original slides were scanned at 0.465 micrometres/pixel and rescaled to 0.620 micrometres/pixel for the distributed tiles. BMP examples do not embed a reliable calibration.
glas.annotation: Expert-drawn individual gland boundaries. Positive pixel values identify gland instances, not tumor or stroma classes. Image-level grade is separate.

crag.note: Published resolution of the original CRAG release; canonical release is not acquired.
crag.annotation: Original release has expert gland instance annotations; these do not provide a general tumor/stroma tissue ontology.

crag-candidate.note: Original CRAG is reported at 0.55 micrometres/pixel (20x). The candidate mirror has no calibration metadata or documented processing history; that spacing cannot yet be assigned to its files.
crag-candidate.annotation: Integer gland-instance-style masks are present, but original annotation fidelity/provenance is unverified; no tumor/stroma class labels.

paip2019.note: Provider reports scanning at 20x. Micrometres/pixel must be obtained from approved SVS files; do not infer it from magnification alone.
paip2019.annotation: Provider training masks separately annotate whole tumor and viable tumor; data are pending approved access.

wsss4luad.scanner: Leica GT 450 (GDPH source slides; TCGA slides heterogeneous)
wsss4luad.note: Challenge paper states all distributed patches are at 10x. GDPH source slides scanned at 40x / 0.2517 micrometres per pixel; no explicit calibration verified for pinned mirror patches. Source-slide spacing is not assigned to downsampled patches. Preserve native distributed dimensions.
wsss4luad.annotation: Pathologist-in-the-loop masks: model proposals manually refined, then reviewed by expert board. Validation has tumor epithelium, tumor-associated stroma and normal tissue; white background excluded. Mirror test pairs rejected by geometry audit.

rings-glands.note: Attached PathSegmentor Table A1 lists 100x. Released 1500 x 1500 PNGs have no pixel-spacing metadata. Objective versus total magnification is unresolved; do not convert 100x into micrometres/pixel.
rings-glands.annotation: Manual binary gland masks supplied with the original RINGS release; positive values do not encode individual gland instances.

rings-tumor.note: Attached PathSegmentor Table A1 lists 100x. Released 1500 x 1500 PNGs have no pixel-spacing metadata. Objective versus total magnification is unresolved; do not convert 100x into micrometres/pixel.
rings-tumor.annotation: Manual binary cancer tissue masks supplied separately from gland masks. The complement is not an exhaustive stroma class.

cocahis-vista.note: Author-released 1024 x 1024 processed training patches. Exact resampling, original physical spacing, stain variant and annotator aggregation are undocumented in this subset. Attached paper Table A1 reports original CoCaHis as 40x; that cannot calibrate this derivative.
cocahis-vista.annotation: 302 supplied binary image/mask pairs derived from CoCaHis. Original annotations concern metastatic colorectal cancer in liver; this release foreground mapping has not been independently reconciled. Treat as a staged exploratory subset.
